items.title: 法官駁回阿拉斯加州參議院選舉訴訟；司法部誓言提起上訴
items.titleEn: Judge dismisses Alaska Senate election lawsuit; DOJ vows appeal
items.titleZh: 法官駁回阿拉斯加州參議院選舉訴訟；司法部誓言提起上訴
items.summaryEn: Democratic nominee Mary Peltola is facing two candidates named Dan Sullivan in the Alaska Senate election, one of whom is the Republican incumbent.
items.summaryZh: 民主黨候選人瑪麗·佩爾托拉在阿拉斯加州參議院選舉中將面臨兩位名叫丹·沙利文的候選人，其中一位是共和黨現任參議員。

items.title: 幣安表示，目前已彌補了63億美元駭客攻擊損失中的90%，並計劃在週日恢復提現。
items.titleEn: Binance says 90% of $6.3 billion hack losses are now covered, plans to resume withdrawals Sunday
items.titleZh: 幣安表示，目前已彌補了63億美元駭客攻擊損失中的90%，並計劃在週日恢復提現。
items.summaryEn: Binance says it has restored backing for 90% of assets affected by its $6.3 billion hack and is planning to resume withdrawals, subject to security checks.
items.summaryZh: 幣安表示，已恢復了受 63 億美元駭客攻擊影響的 90% 資產的資金，並計劃在進行安全檢查後恢復提現。

items.title: Anthropic 進軍納斯達克的道路變得更加坎坷。
items.titleEn: Anthropic's path to the Nasdaq just got a lot bumpier
items.titleZh: Anthropic 進軍納斯達克的道路變得更加坎坷。
items.summaryEn: Concerning projections from hyperscalers this week punished tech stocks and pushed the Nasdaq to its first three-week losing streak since March.
items.summaryZh: 本週超大規模資料中心營運商令人擔憂的預測打擊了科技股，並導致納斯達克指數自 3 月以來首次連續三週下跌。

items.title: 亞馬遜和英特爾財報發布後，投資人拋售科技股，那斯達克指數下跌逾2%：即時更新
items.titleEn: Nasdaq falls more than 2% as investors rotate out of tech after Amazon, Intel earnings: Live updates
items.titleZh: 亞馬遜和英特爾財報發布後，投資人拋售科技股，那斯達克指數下跌逾2%：即時更新
items.summaryEn: Amazon and Intel shares tumbled after the companies posted their latest earnings reports.
items.summaryZh: 亞馬遜和英特爾發布最新財報後，股價暴跌。

items.title: Alphabet 財報不如預期，這首次真正表明人工智慧正在蠶食搜尋業務。
items.titleEn: Alphabet earnings miss reflects first real sign that AI is taking a bite out of search
items.titleZh: Alphabet 財報不如預期，這首次真正表明人工智慧正在蠶食搜尋業務。
items.summaryEn: Wall Street hammered Alphabet for an earnings miss that included weaker-than-expected revenue out of the company's core business.
items.summaryZh: 由於Alphabet的獲利不如預期，包括其核心業務收入低於預期，華爾街對其進行了猛烈抨擊。

items.title: 聯準會會議即時更新：預計不會升息，但投資人密切關注沃什的下一步動向。

items.summaryEn: Markets are pricing in less than a 10% chance that the FOMC follows up its quarter--point hike in September with another increase.
items.summaryZh: 市場預期，聯準會在9月升息25個基點後再次升息的可能性不到10%。
